The moment you enter Varanasi, it hits you—the colors, the smells, the sheer vibrance of the city. There’s nowhere else like it. From the chaotic streets to the calm of the Ganga, every corner has a vibe.

The Ganga Aarti at night is surreal. This is a city where life, death, and everything in between can be captured in a single frame.

28 states, 6 UTs, 20,000 km—some places don’t just exist, they overwhelm your senses. 🇮🇳 #LucknowToVaranasi #CulturalCapital #cfmoto #cfmotoindia #cfmotoofficial #cfmoto650mt #thegreatindiaride

media/stories/202503/17873684439220105.m.caption:
Surprising (to me) Facts About Nagaland

	•  English is widely spoken and well understood. 

	•  The entire state is made up of numerous villages, each with a communal space and a large playground.

	•  Sports, especially football, are taken very seriously and played everywhere.

	•  People have strong civic sense (compared to rest of India)

 •  Every village is neat and  clean & the quality of life is much higher (than I thought)

media/reels/202504/17854715319409946.mp4.caption:
Varanasi to Lumbini—crossing into Nepal :)

From the birthplace of Buddha to monasteries built by countries around the world, Lumbini is a reminder of how far his teachings have traveled.

& absolutely magical night sky - No city lights(which is a stark contrast to India)

28 states, 6 UTs, 20,000 km—now in Nepal #VaranasiToLumbini #cfmoto #cfmotoindia #cfmotoofficial #cfmoto650mt #thegreatindiaride

media/reels/202504/18269826001256432.mp4.caption:
Lumbini to Pokhara—stunning views and some seriously rough roads!

Got lucky with some riding company in Nepal. But I definitely underestimated the road conditions here—tough on both me and the bike. 

By the time I reached Pokhara, I was completely drained.🥲

Still, the views made it all worth it :) Nepal is something else. 🇳🇵

28 states, 6 UTs, 20,000 km—some roads test you, but the journey is always worth it. #RoughRoadsGreatViews #cfmoto #cfmotoindia #cfmotoofficial #cfmoto650mt #thegreatindiaride

media/reels/202504/17980094927683502.mp4.caption:
Twisties, landslides, dust, traffic— name it, this stretch had it. Took way longer than expected and felt like I was in an off-road rally at times 😅

But reaching Kathmandu felt like a reward in itself. Bustling city, unique vibe, and that feeling of making it through a tough ride. Nepal keeps testing, but it also keeps giving. 🇳🇵

28 states, 6 UTs, 20,000 km—every tough day leads to a great destination. #PokharaToKathmandu #MountainChaos #MadeItToKathmandu #thegreatindiaride #cfmoto #cfmotoindia #cfmotoofficial #cfmoto650mt #thegreatindiaride

media/reels/202504/17926052747938753.mp4.caption:
probably the roughest stretch yet.

Some roads were just… not there. 😅 Riding through dust, rocks, and chaos, with the chain starting to complain halfway through—clogged up with all the dirt and debris.

But the landscape was absolutely stunning!

The border areas of Nepal feel a lot like India, but places like Pokhara and Kathmandu—they’ve got their own unique vibe and charm :)

28 states, 6 UTs, 20,000 km—and Nepal, you’ve been wild and beautiful. 🇳🇵 #KathmanduToJanakpur #NoRoadsNoProblem #DustyButBeautiful #cfmoto #cfmotoindia #cfmotoofficial #cfmoto650mt #thegreatindiaride
